J.population: Unrelated western-European adults selected for GWAS, preferring the oldest family members. Exclusions: diabetes by self-report or FPG >=7.0 mmol/L; anemia at the reported sex-specific thresholds; missing HbA1c, erythrocytes or FPG. Source context: CTX_JANSEN_SELECTED. Reported marginal sample count is source-specific, not target size or a guaranteed regression/pair count. Direct eligible-population scenario A01.
J.measurement: J: age integer years; female membership 1=female,0=male; BMI kg/m^2; glucose is fresh fasting plasma hexokinase/G6PD FPG mmol/L; hba1c is NGSP-percent representation of IFCC-standardized immunoassay HbA1c via U_NGSP_SCALE. Fasting hours and original age rounding unreported.

M.population: Selected 2019 rural Yanlou/Shandong follow-up, age 61-80, free of dementia and functional disability; known diabetes included. Demographics/BMI collected in 2018, laboratory measurements in 2019. Source context: CTX_MIND_ANALYZED. Reported marginal sample count is source-specific, not target size or a guaranteed regression/pair count. Direct eligible-population scenario A01.
M.measurement: M: integer age years and female membership 1=female,0=male; prior-year BMI kg/m^2; glucose is serum FSG mmol/L, glucose oxidase CS-600B within two hours; overnight fasting exact hours unreported; hba1c is EDTA whole-blood HPLC Huizhong MQ6000 percent within two days. Separate plasma measurement is not used.
